description: WinUI packaging fails with APPX1101 duplicate `.pdb` payload after enabling publish trimming, based on https://github.com/microsoft/microsoft-ui-xaml/issues/9634.
prompt:
Our GitHub Actions build for a WinUI 3 app started failing on the second package build after we enabled trimming for Release. Local Debug is fine.

error APPX1101: Payload contains two or more files with the same destination path 'Starboard.pdb'.
